correctness.rationale: For h=r(x0)-r(xhat), exact sketched normal equations give <Sz,Sh>=0 and delta=||Sh||²/||Sz||². Injection of S on W defines M=(S|W)^{-T}(S|W)^{-1} with alpha I <= M <= beta I, alpha=1/(1+eps), beta=1/(1-eps). Restriction to the orthonormal sketch residual/difference plane yields true improvement / Ghat = tr(M K), K=[[0,sqrt(delta)],[sqrt(delta),delta]]. K has eigenvalues lambda_±=(delta ± sqrt(delta(delta+4)))/2. The exact minimum alpha lambda_+ + beta lambda_- equals Psi_eps(delta), attained when the M-beta eigendirection equals the negative eigendirection of K. Choosing r(x)=M^{1/2}(1,x sqrt(delta)), S=M^{-1/2}, xhat=0, x0=1 attains every delta>0. Sign analysis proves the threshold only for positive delta. At delta=0 both residuals coincide by sketch injection, and at Ghat=0 Fhat=0. Exact rational witness at eps=4/5,delta=9/4 gives F0-Fhat=-25/12. The actual standalone script verify.py ran successfully with VERIFY_OK rational_witness=1 sharp_extremizers_and_comparisons=5000. Finite checks supplement the universal analytic argument.

value.rationale: The 2025 motivating paper proves monotonicity only for delta >= 2eps/(1-eps), explicitly identifies that sufficient test as frequently too stringent, and proposes sketch refinement or restart as future work. For an exact sketched minimizer, the new complete sharp threshold delta >= 4eps²/(1-eps²) for delta>0 is order eps² rather than eps, and a quantitative lower bound allows certificate design with measured delta. Equality and ascent families prove that the acceptance frontier cannot be improved from only the stated information. The result is motivated by algorithmic stability of sketched majorant subproblems, not an arbitrary isolated calculation; standard normal equations are used but not presented as novel. Applications to nonlinear majorants are explicitly conditional.
